summary: CEU3Dialog's default answers, and which slot CConfirmRemoveAll overrides.

addresses.name: CEU3Dialog::Close
addresses.comment: `mov byte [ecx+0x64], 1; ret` - the dialog marked done. CEU3Dialog's slots 5 and 6, the two answers a dialog gives by default; CConfirmRemoveAll overrides slot 5 alone (OnConfirm, which sets +0x64 itself after posting its command), so slot 5 is inferred the agreeing answer and slot 6 the declining one, which only closes. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leaderwindow.md, section 7.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x670BC0..0x670BC4; vtable.py CEU3Dialog CConfirmRemoveAll: slot 5 0x670BC0 and 0x748840, slot 6 0x670BC0 in both. Which button reaches which slot was not followed past the generic registration at 0x4355B0.

addresses.name: CRemoveAllLeadersCommand::Execute
addresses.comment:
**What the "unassign all leaders" button does**, and the command the `CONFIRM_REMOVEAll` dialog queues when it is confirmed. Virtual **slot 6** of `CRemoveAllLeadersCommand`; `this` in ECX, no stack arguments, one bare `ret` at 0x5D8655 with nine `int3` after it and slot 7 (`mov eax, 0x5d8; ret`, the command's save token) at 0x5D8660.

It resolves its own country - `this->+0x40` is a country id, indexed into `g_CCountryDataBase (0x1A855A4) ->+0x16C` - and walks that country's `units` (`CCountry +0xBAC`), `edi` holding each unit and `[esp+0x14]` the next node. Per unit:

- **0x5D84A1: `cmp [edi+0x290], ebx` / `jne 0x5D863A`** - skip a unit whose `expeditionary_owner`'s id is set, i.e. one on loan to another country. This is the loop's only skip.
- 0x5D856C: `cmp [edi+0x128], ecx` against the game state's `player_tag`'s id (+0xC34). This gates **only the two message strings** built at 0x5D8590-0x5D8617, not the work: both arms fall into the call below.
- **0x5D8635: `call 0x5BFC10`** with the unit in ECX and `(eax, 1, 0)` on the stack - the per-unit strip - **`CUnit::SetLeader`**, now recorded at rva 0x1BFC10. It opens `mov edi, ecx; mov ecx, [edi+0x12c]`, reading `CUnit::leader_ptr`, which is what says this is the leader detach. `ret 0xc`, in no virtual table, 23 callers. It was left unnamed here at first, on the grounds that a name taken from one caller would be trap 14's `tutorial_active` again - and then trap 14's *other* half answered it: `CLeader::null`'s comment already called the call at 0x1D7DA7 `CUnit::SetLeader`, so the record held the name all along.

So the "all" is implicit in the loop - the command carries a country and nothing about units - which is why making it act on a selection is a change to the skip test rather than to the command. The dialog itself is `CConfirmRemoveAll`, whose only override of `CEU3Dialog` is slot 5 at rva 0x348840 (OnConfirm); slot 6 stays CEU3Dialog::Close (0x270BC0), which is also the base's slot 5 - corrected 2026-10-11, see reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leaderwindow.md, section 7.
addresses.evidence: vtable.py CEU3Dialog CConfirmRemoveAll: CConfirmRemoveAll differs from its base in slot 5 only.
addresses.revises: Said CConfirmRemoveAll put one body in both slots 5 and 6; it overrides slot 5 alone - both slots hold one body in the base, CEU3Dialog.

slots_noted: CConfirmRemoveAll slot 5 is already recorded as OnConfirm.
